summary: Memchr::next returned the updated cursor position, one byte beyond each match, producing one-based indices. The fix returns the zero-based match position while advancing the cursor past it. This reversal restores only the original forward-iterator implementation in src/lib.rs. The fix-added tests::qc_memchr1_iter compares its results with an enumerated byte scan and detects incorrect offsets when generated data contains a zero byte. No tests were run.
